craft_notes: Sthāyin: Awaiting inside surrender (pratīkṣā). End-dash→comma (unmaking softens onto oneness). Rejected: 'spendthrift' gloss — kept wastrel. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail to unmake the is and is-not to nought or aught,
to tied and untied, the wastrel-sovereign in one.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sadasatāṃ kartum asattvaṃ sattvam eva vā svatantrāyāsvatantrāya vyayaiśvaryaikaśāline

reads_against.argmap: Bow to make real-and-unreal into non-being or being indeed. → Bow to the free-unfree one embodying loss and lordship.
c1_essence: Real and fake made nought or aught by free-and-bound spender-sovereign.

l2.plain_english: Homage to turn the real and the fake to nought or to aught — to the bound and the free, who wears wasting and sway as one.
l2.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sadasatāṃ kartum asattvaṃ sattvam eva vā svatantrāyāsvatantrāya vyayaiśvaryaikaśāline
